question: Does the extra paid-archive genotype supply create useful NEW offspring with the unchanged job-aligned kernel, beyond complete pooled accepted histories/current/initial or random known sources?
sampling: All six original first-generation CENTER windows per instance (step0/24/49, both source seeds). Eight equally spaced freeCENTER recipients among47; retain their actual oldest personal ND guide by full owner index. No outcome/window/parent replacement.

sources.PAID_ND: Actual all-paid archive at request; already ND and objective-deduplicated.
sources.HISTORY_ND: ND of full100initial+100current+all current personal histories.
sources.RANDOM_KNOWN: Uniform over all known encoded inputs from those sources; not a sample of all previously attempted candidates, which were not all saved.

ndTies: Chronological first paid occurrence, then full encoding. One genotype for equal objective vector within ND construction; exact source/genome duplicates merged in common input reconstruction, membership/provenance retained. No offspring deduplication before payment.
kernel: Actual frozen KernelVariants.JOB_ALIGNED, native six independent paper resource triggers and repairs; unchanged config, parent and actual personal guide. Only global guide source varies. No candidate acceptance/local search/Q update or mainline modification.
randomness: Each recipient/rep gets one uniform quantile from an independent selector RNG shared across source methods. Kernel RNG reset to identical starting seed after selection. Different guide/resource/repair paths need not consume subsequent draws identically.
budget: Common unique encoded source inputs per context replayed through RunContext once and charged, including across-context repeats; then6contexts*8parents*16draws*5methods=3840charged offspring per instance,7680total. All paid inputs/offspring also full-timeline QA separately. Exact setup+totalFE frozen after deterministic input preparation, before decoding.
comparison: Equal128offspring per source per context on fixed parents/pbest. Shared paid source reconstruction is data-generation cost, not five independently executed full optimizers. This is not complete-algorithm sameFE/time evidence.
cost: Record every source reconstruction/evaluation and QA separately. Pool construction for current/history/paid/random perrep amortized over exactly8children. INITIAL_ND cached once per context, cost divided by128actual children. Measure guide draw/copy, generation, repair and guarded evaluation. These are necessary frozen-pool costs; live archive snapshot/cache API, maintenance and closed-loop timing remain unvalidated.
scoring: Single-candidate HV increase against the complete actual pre-request paid archive. All teacher/personal/parent points must score zero extra HV. Average16draws per recipient,48recipient-context clusters per instance. Never union all16children and call that one candidate. Normalization/source fixed; ref1.5primary,1.25/2sensitivity.
gate: Each instance>=24of48informative recipient clusters. PAID_ND mean single gain>=10% overHISTORY_ND andINITIAL_ND,>=5%overCURRENT_ND andRANDOM_KNOWN. >=27of48strict recipient wins vsHISTORY_ND andRANDOM_KNOWN. Each source-seed aggregate positive vsboth; each step aggregate nonnegative vsHISTORY_ND; ref1.25/2 directions vsboth positive. Median necessary per-child pool+draw/copy+kernel+evaluation cost ratio<=1.25 vsHISTORY_ND andINITIAL_ND. Zero controls inconclusive. All necessary. Failure stops this fixed source rule, without teacher rank/pool subset/seed/window/kernel tuning.
engineering: Actual classes/JDK/SHA frozen. Every imported source paid no later than request; full source objective replay bit-exact. Every paid offspring complete timeline matches independent full decoder. Source vectors/objectives unchanged. Pool membership and ND objective sets independently recomputed, complete paidFE ledger1..last; failures retain fee receipts and last valid front.
nextIfPass: Only a fresh protocol for native archive-read costs and closed loop, including uniform duties and strong classical all-paid-guide feedback. Extra supply mostly MAKESPAN at these windows cannot establish four-role unique cooperation.
limits: Reused development sources and conditional single-offspring mechanism; no novel archive method, full algorithm superiority, fatigue specificity, same-time gain, independent confirmation or Li author-result reproduction. Original four roles/QGS/families/shared rules and default decoder untouched. No downloads, transfers or public push.
